capabilities: Read the open Japanese note aloud
Remove frontmatter, code, URLs and images before speech
Split Japanese text into speech-sized segments
Highlight the current passage in a sidebar transcript
Switch between Google Cloud and device voices
extras: Free plugin; Google Cloud usage is billed to the user's own project and credentials are kept in Obsidian SecretStorage. Settings include one link to VaultCast, a separate iOS app by the same author (free with own API key, or a ¥1,500 one-time in-app purchase). Playback while the screen is locked or the app is in the background is not guaranteed; Android and iPad are untested.
motivation: The author wanted to review saved articles and reading notes in Obsidian without staring at the screen.
problem: Listening to Japanese notes meant copying text into another app, and raw Markdown symbols and long sentences break speech synthesis.

relations.evidence: アーキテクチャの検討ではObsidian Voiceを参考にしました。

summary: Plugin that reads Japanese Markdown notes aloud with Google Cloud text-to-speech or device voices, plus a sidebar transcript player.
